column1: # The docgen domain: the fragments a generated document is assembled from, not diagnostics.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   id     dotted <domain>.<snake_case>, stable forever, never renumbered, never recycled
#   owner  "local" (this repository owns the text) or "import" (the pinned module does)
#   ctx    where the message is raised, for the translator
#   note   what it means, for the translator
#   src    for a local row, the same text as the source-language value; for an imported one, what the
#          pinned module ships, checked against it at generation time
#   en     the English rendering (the source language)
#   zh     the Chinese rendering
# Both text columns are copied out of internal/i18n/table_docgen.go by the migration script, never
# retyped: transcription is the migration's real risk, and a hand-typed row got a full-width parenthesis
# wrong on the first attempt. The column-by-column diff against the old table is the mitigation.
# Order is load order within this file and file order across files; see tables.tsv. New rows append.
# One row of the old text-keyed table is deliberately not here: the "_（没有可导出的符号）_" entry with no
# trailing newline. It had no call site anywhere in the repository and no lookup against it, so it was
# unreachable in the old design too — a text-keyed catalog cannot tell a dead entry from a live one,
# because nothing maps an entry to the code that uses it.
